ideas.pitch: An interactive web app tailored for students to visualize complex Java memory models, JVM garbage collection cycles, and step-by-step execution trees for tricky DSA problems like longest subarray with equal zeros and ones.
ideas.title: JavaOA-Visualizer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets the core domains of the assessment—Java concepts, technical fundamentals, and algorithm execution—making it instantly relevant to the evaluators.

ideas.pitch: A benchmarking utility specifically written in core Java to profile performance trade-offs between different algorithmic approaches for interval and array-based DSA problems.
ideas.title: AlgoBench-Java
ideas.why_it_could_win: Aligns tightly with the technical assessment focus on data structures, algorithms, and fundamental Java programming mechanics.

ideas.pitch: A specialized quiz and concept-mapping tool designed to drill students on DBMS normalization and Computer Networks protocols in preparation for technical OAs.
ideas.title: DBMS-Network-FlashCards
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses the exact technical MCQ sections of the assessment, offering immediate practical utility for anyone studying for the exam format.

ideas.pitch: A timed online assessment simulator featuring automated test case execution for array manipulation and sliding window problems under strict time constraints.
ideas.title: OAMock-Simulator
ideas.why_it_could_win: Mimics the exact online assessment environment and constraints that the event itself is evaluating participants on.

ideas.pitch: A lightweight static analysis tool written in Java that scans legacy codebases to identify and refactor anti-patterns related to core Java memory management and concurrency.
ideas.title: JavaCore-RefactorBot
ideas.why_it_could_win: Demonstrates deep mastery of advanced Java programming concepts, directly scoring high against the technical criteria of the evaluation.
